'''Sepanik Memorial Hospital''' was a [[Medcenter/Legends|hospital]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] that was destroyed in the [[Destruction of Taris|bombardment]] of the planet in [[3956 BBY]]. It was one of several hospitals that had a stock of [[rakghoul serum]], and [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] later its ruins were raided by the [[Death's Claw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] for the serum. [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Ianna Cel]] appealed to [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Viqui]] of the [[Republic Army]] to step in, but as Sepanik had not been a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] hospital, the pirates had legal salvage rights.
